name: Eastman Double-X Negative Film 5222 / 7222
notes: Read from the current raster copy (H-1-5222, March 2022, kodak-double-x.pdf), the only copy available. Hints were placed on the printed lines by locating the ink of the rendered page (columns of each line, ranked top to bottom).

Exposure indexes printed 'for development to a gamma of 0.65': tungsten (3200 K) 200, daylight 250. The curves are for daylight, 1/50 s with an intensity-scale sensitometer, so balance is daylight and iso 250.

Characteristic curves: x axis is absolute log exposure in lux-seconds as printed (the left label -3.0, then -2.0, -1.0, 0.0 and 1.0 at the right frame; the minus signs are drawn as bars above the numbers). Five development times in KODAK D-96 at 21 C (70 F): 4 min (gamma 0.50, line v-d96-4), 5 min (0.56, v-d96-5), 6 1/2 min (0.66, line v, the development closest to the recommended control gamma 0.65 to 0.70 given in the processing table and to the gamma 0.65 the exposure indexes refer to), 9 min (0.84, v-d96-9) and 12 min (1.05, v-d96-12). All five start together at log exposure -3.0 (density about 0.22 to 0.30) and the lines are drawn up to log exposure -0.4 only; below about -2.6 the three flattest curves run into one line, so their separation there is within about 0.02 density. The small time-gamma and time-fog inset is not traced.
Gamma is calculated with Status M densitometry (blue) per the processing table; the density axis runs 0 to 4 and the curves are the printed lines only (no fog subtraction is applied).

Spectral sensitivity: exposure 1.4 s, D-96 developed to the recommended control gamma, Diffuse Visual densitometry; y is log sensitivity (reciprocal exposure in ergs/cm2) as printed, axis -1.0 to 3.0. The sheet draws two curves: D = 0.3 above gross fog (line v, drawn from 400 to about 670 nm) and D = 1.0 above gross fog (line v-d1.0, from about 420 to 660 nm); the second is named as an alternate because the README only defines v for a single curve.

Grain: diffuse rms granularity 14, read at a net diffuse visual density of 1.0 with a 48 micrometre aperture (printed in the Image Structure table); developed in D-96 to the recommended control gamma. Resolving power printed: TOC 1.6:1 gives 32 lines/mm, TOC 1000:1 gives 100 lines/mm.
No Log H Ref or grey-card density table is printed, so log_h_ref is null.
